back.target: to be sorry; used impersonally with a dative, so es tut mir leid means I'm sorry (literally it causes me sorrow)

note: The hint is needed because it rules out bedauern and sich entschuldigen; the editor could also mention that leidtun is impersonal, with the thing as subject and the sorry person in the dative (es tut mir leid, das tut ihm leid).
